**Q1: How can an attacker exploit a pre-authentication RCE vulnerability in React Server Components (e.g., CVE-2025-55182) to achieve code execution on a web server?**

**Answer:**
CVE-2025-55182 is a critical (CVSS 10.0) pre-authentication remote code execution (RCE) flaw in React Server Components (RSC), a feature introduced in Next.js 13+ that enables server-side rendering of React components.
